records.name: Reg Patchday
records.biography_en: Reg Patchday works the Reset Detail with The Routine Restoration Office. When a player leaves another HyperNorm block in pieces, the crew returns with familiar tools and a fresh estimate. Reg Patchday takes pride in leaving one small part of the district easier to live in.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Reg Patchday has seen this corner before. The building was facing another direction then.
